variants.name: Синие ступени

variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single landscape 16:9 polished Roblox Ball Ocean Depths game environment concept. Input images are STYLE AND LAYOUT REFERENCES ONLY: retain their very long straight wide football lane in diagonal perspective from large lower-left foreground to distant upper-right endpoint, elevated 3/4 view, blocky handmade faceted toy-brick forms and square studs. Create a NEW Jellyfish Canyon environment, remove ships, kelp and ordinary coral landmarks. Blue underwater fissure with schools of pink and pale blue jellyfish. All rock forms rooted in visible continuous seabed, broad complete terraces, no floating rocks, full footprint support. Jellyfish float in the water over SIDE banks, never inside the central air/ball-flight corridor. Central lane and all space above it remain completely unobstructed. Pale blue-ivory checked lane with thin white football markings and turquoise edges. A sequence of small soft pink/cyan light blooms along the SIDE edges evokes a traveling pulse, not lasers or barriers. Bright enough to read entire lane and side terrain, clean saturated colors, expensive polished game aesthetic, underwater caustics. No text, labels, UI, logos, collage, photorealism, bridge over lane, nightclub, blackness or excessive neon. COMPOSITION A: broad open sunlit blue canyon, low asymmetric stepped blue rock terraces on both sides, large faceted pink jellyfish school at left middle depth and smaller cyan school at right, bright ivory-blue checked lane. Spacious clear turquoise water, light shafts from visible surface. Terrain only about one-third image height, no tall walls. Pink/cyan pulses small and restrained, daylight dominant.
